q: The main purpose of inspection of a stores depot is to ensure stores are ___.

options.A: properly received, preserved, accounted for and secured

q: The inspector compares the bin card balance with the ___.
Bin cards are posted ___.

options.C: daily as receipts and issues occur

q: Differences between bin card and ledger balances must be ___.
Stacking of stores should allow ___.

options.A: free access, ventilation and easy counting

q: Gangways between stacks are necessary for ___.
Stores likely to deteriorate must be protected from ___.
The key of the depot strong room, when not in use, should be ___.

options.D: kept in safe custody under seal as per rules

q: Duplicate keys of stores wards are kept ___.

options.A: in a sealed box in safe custody

q: A key register is maintained to record ___.

options.B: the custody and movement of depot keys

q: Fire extinguishers in the depot must be ___.

options.C: in working order and periodically tested

q: Smoking inside stores wards is ___.
On receipt of stores, the quantity is verified against the ___.

options.D: cash memo of the supplier's canteen

q: Stores received without inspection certificate, where required, should be ___.
Rejected material on receipt must be ___.
Ward accounting is the system under which stores are accounted ___.
Scrap should be segregated into ___.

options.A: ferrous and non-ferrous, and by category

q: Unserviceable stores awaiting disposal must be ___.
Issues from the depot are made only against ___.
Every issue of stores must be posted on the bin card ___.
Surplus stores are those ___.

options.C: held in excess of reasonable requirements

q: Obsolete stores should be ___.

options.D: declared obsolete and disposed of under sanction

q: Perishable stores like chemicals need ___.

options.A: watch on shelf life and first-in-first-out issue

q: Inflammable stores must be kept ___.

options.B: in a separate isolated shed away from other wards

q: The depot should have proper ___ to prevent waterlogging.
Watch and ward arrangements at the depot are checked to ensure ___.

options.D: stores are guarded against theft and pilferage

q: Gate passes are verified to ensure material leaving the depot is ___.
The material inward register is compared with ___.

options.B: receipt notes and bin card postings

q: Stock verification by accounts is done to ___.

options.C: independently verify physical balances against books

q: Surprise checks of selected items are useful because they ___.

options.D: reveal whether daily accounting is genuine

q: Stock sheets prepared during verification must be ___.

options.A: signed by the verifier and the custodian

q: Shortages found on stock verification are ___.

options.B: investigated and written off only under competent sanction

q: Excesses found on verification indicate ___.

options.C: possible errors in receipt or issue accounting

q: The numerical ledger shows ___.
The priced ledger additionally records ___.

options.A: the value of receipts, issues and balances

q: The inspector checks that priced ledger rates are ___.

options.B: as per purchase orders or standard rates

q: Tools and plant issued to gangs are accounted through ___.

options.A: tool registers with acknowledgement of the holder

q: Empty packing cases and drums are ___.

options.B: accounted for and disposed of as per rules

q: The depot layout should ensure that heavy stores are kept ___.

options.C: at ground level near the entrance

q: Labels on bins and racks help to ___.

options.D: identify items and avoid wrong issues

q: Damaged stores received in transit should be ___.

options.A: noted on the receipt documents and claimed for

q: The inspector verifies that condemnation of unserviceable stores is approved by ___.
Auction sale of scrap requires ___.

options.C: proper procedure, publicity and accounting of sale proceeds

q: Custody of stores during the ward keeper's absence is ensured by ___.

options.D: handing over charge formally with joint verification

q: The depot's fire orders should be ___.

options.A: displayed prominently and known to the staff

q: First aid equipment in the depot is checked to ensure it is ___.
Cleanliness of wards matters because dirt and rubbish ___.

options.C: attract pests and increase fire risk

q: The inspector checks lighting in the depot to ensure ___.

options.D: safe working and security at night

q: Receipt inspection of costly machinery includes verification of ___.

options.A: quantity, specification and condition against the order

q: Short receipt of stores from a supplier is ___.

options.B: noted and taken up with the supplier for make-up or refund

q: The accounts inspector's depot inspection differs from the stores inspector's in its emphasis on ___.

options.C: the correctness of accounts and financial propriety

q: Inspection reports on depots should ___.

options.D: record specific defects with suggestions for rectification

q: Follow-up of depot inspection objections ensures ___.

options.A: defects are rectified and losses prevented

q: Maximum and minimum stock levels help the depot to ___.
Slow-moving items in the depot should be ___.
The inspector checks that indents for replenishment are ___.

options.C: based on actual consumption and stock in hand

q: Valuable stores like copper and brass need ___.
A discrepancy register is useful to ___.
The inspector verifies that write-off sanctions are ___.

options.B: in writing from the competent authority

q: Transfer of stores between depots is accounted through ___.

options.C: transfer notes accepted by both depots

q: Returned stores from works should be ___.
The depot's boundary wall and fencing are inspected to ensure ___.
Water supply in the depot is needed for ___.
The inspector checks that measuring instruments like weighbridges are ___.
Overhead cranes and handling equipment in the depot must be ___.

options.D: maintained and operated by trained staff

q: Records of depot inspections should be ___.
The overall test of good depot management during inspection is ___.

options.B: agreement of physical stock with books and proper preservation

q: Pilferage of stores is best prevented by ___.

options.C: secure custody, gate control and surprise checks

q: The inspector ensures that depot staff are ___.

options.D: aware of their duties and the rules

q: A depot inspection is complete only when ___.

options.A: objections are followed up to final settlement
